section_summary: This section records Japanese merchant ship movements, bills of health, cargoes and oil shipments across the Pacific, the Americas and Asia in April and May 1941. It includes copies prepared for naval intelligence, a table of 1940 tin shipments, and correspondence about how ship movements should be reported.

people.name: Stanley K. Hornbeck
people.role: State Department adviser referenced in correspondence

people.name: H. D. Bode
people.role: U.S. Navy captain and head of Foreign Intelligence Branch

people.name: Hamilton
people.role: State Department official copied on message

subfiles.title: ARIMA MARU departure from Puntarenas
subfiles.to: Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports ARIMA MARU leaving Puntarenas for Balboa.
subfiles.summary: ARIMA MARU departed Puntarenas for Balboa on May 1.

subfiles.title: COLUMBIA MARU and YAMAURA sailings
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports two vessels sailing for Manila.
subfiles.summary: COLUMBIA MARU sailed April 28 and YAMAURA April 29, both for Manila.

subfiles.title: NITIEI MARU and TOHUZI MARU departures
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports tanker and merchant vessel departures from Japan.
subfiles.summary: NITIEI MARU left Tokuyama for Los Angeles April 27; TOHUZI MARU left Miike for Manila about April 28.

subfiles.title: Delayed departure of Japanese whaling ships
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Navy Department
subfiles.about: Reports a delay affecting two oil-carrying whaling vessels bound for California.
subfiles.summary: Two whaling vessels expected in California May 12 to load crude and diesel oil delayed departure for unknown reasons.

subfiles.title: Bills of health issued at Kobe since April 21
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Lists bills of health and destinations for Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: Lists AWAZISAN, YAMAKAZE, ASAMA MARU, YAMAZATO, KIRISI, NORFOLK and TATSUTA MARU.

subfiles.title: TAKAOKA MARU at Manzanillo
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports cargo handling and a passenger aboard TAKAOKA MARU.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from San Francisco, discharged Japanese cargo, loaded resin and dyes, and was to sail for Balboa. Yoshizo Murata was its sole passenger.

subfiles.title: DAIITI-OGURA, YAMAKAZE and KINUGAWA sailings
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports three departures and their routes.
subfiles.summary: DAIITI-OGURA sailed for San Luis, YAMAKAZE for South America, and KINUGAWA reportedly for Madras and Bombay.

subfiles.title: DAISAN OGURASOA and CANBERRA MARU sailings
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports departures for Los Angeles and Melbourne.
subfiles.summary: Both vessels reportedly sailed May 2, DAISAN OGURASOA for Los Angeles and CANBERRA MARU for Melbourne.

subfiles.title: HAMBURG MARU at Singapore
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports HAMBURG MARU’s arrival and onward route.
subfiles.summary: HAMBURG MARU arrived from Sakito May 2 and left May 4 for Calcutta via Belawan and Rangoon.

subfiles.title: NANA and ARGUN sailings
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports sailings toward South America and South Asia.
subfiles.summary: NANA left May 4 for eastern South America via Los Angeles and Panama Canal. ARGUN reportedly left May 3 for Singapore, Penang, Colombo and Bombay.

subfiles.title: SAGAMI sailing for South America
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports SAGAMI’s route to western South America.
subfiles.summary: SAGAMI sailed May 5 via San Francisco, Los Angeles, Manzanillo and Balboa.

subfiles.title: KYOKUYO MARU bill of health
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports a bill of health for a whale factory vessel.
subfiles.summary: KYOKUYO MARU received a bill of health for San Pedro.

subfiles.title: YAMAGIRI MARU at Santos
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports YAMAGIRI MARU’s South American movement.
subfiles.summary: YAMAGIRI MARU arrived at Santos from Kobe May 4 and sailed for Buenos Aires May 6.

subfiles.title: TOA MARU at Fortaleza
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports TOA MARU’s call and onward itinerary.
subfiles.summary: TOA MARU arrived May 7 from Rio de Janeiro and departed May 8 for Cristóbal, Balboa, Los Angeles, Yokohama and Kobe.

subfiles.title: SANUKI MARU cargo at Manzanillo
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Details strategic materials loaded by SANUKI MARU.
subfiles.summary: Arriving from Huacho, SANUKI MARU loaded fluorspar, turpentine, scrap tin, steel, other metals, mercury and mica before sailing for Japan via Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: SANYO MARU sailing for New York
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports SANYO MARU’s departure and route.
subfiles.summary: SANYO MARU sailed May 6 for New York via San Francisco, Los Angeles and Cristóbal.

subfiles.title: Bills of health issued at Kobe since April 28
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Lists vessels receiving bills of health and their destinations.
subfiles.summary: Lists SAGAMI, NANA, SANYO, HIE, ALUMA, YUZAN and TONAN NO. 3, the last bound for Los Angeles to load oil and gasoline.

subfiles.title: HIE sailing to Seattle and Vancouver
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports HIE’s North American route.
subfiles.summary: HIE sailed May 7 for Seattle and Vancouver.

subfiles.title: Scheduled Japanese tanker liftings of special crude oil
subfiles.to: Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Reports eight tankers scheduled to carry special San Joaquin Valley crude to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Eight tankers were expected to load about 680,000 barrels in California.

subfiles.title: Tanker oil memorandum to War Department
subfiles.to: Chief, Liaison Branch, War Department
subfiles.about: Forwards information on eight Japanese tankers carrying high-octane crude.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the State Department memorandum on eight tanker shipments.

subfiles.title: Tanker oil memorandum to Navy Department
subfiles.to: Director, Central Division, Navy Department
subfiles.about: Forwards information on eight Japanese tankers carrying high-octane crude.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the State Department memorandum on eight tanker shipments.

subfiles.title: ARABIA MARU at Pernambuco
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports ARABIA MARU’s arrival and South American itinerary.
subfiles.summary: ARABIA MARU arrived from Baltimore May 9 and departed the same day for Brazilian, Uruguayan and Argentine ports.

subfiles.title: YAMAGIRI MARU at Montevideo
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Navy Department
subfiles.about: Reports YAMAGIRI MARU’s arrival and planned departure.
subfiles.summary: YAMAGIRI MARU arrived from Santos May 10 and was to sail that night for Buenos Aires.

subfiles.title: SUWA at Thursday Island
subfiles.to: Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Reports SUWA’s Australian port call.
subfiles.summary: SUWA arrived from Davao May 9 and left for Townsville the same day.

subfiles.title: AZUMA and KIYO sailings
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Navy Department
subfiles.about: Reports a merchant ship and tanker leaving Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: AZUMA sailed May 8 for New York via Pacific and Canal Zone ports; tanker KIYO left for San Francisco.

subfiles.title: Navy-chartered tanker KOKUYO
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Navy Department
subfiles.about: Reports KOKUYO’s charter, oil-loading voyage and naval personnel aboard.
subfiles.summary: KOKUYO was expected to leave Kure May 13 for Los Angeles to load oil and gasoline, carrying fifteen Japanese Navy personnel.

subfiles.title: NOSIRO MARU carrying cargo from MARINA O
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports lead and cotton loaded from an ex-Italian vessel.
subfiles.summary: NOSIRO MARU left Tampico for Los Angeles and Japan with 2,500 tons of lead and 960 tons of cotton from MARINA O’s cargo.

subfiles.title: SAKITO MARU at Antofagasta
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports SAKITO MARU’s Chilean movements.
subfiles.summary: SAKITO MARU arrived from Caldera May 10 and departed for Tocopilla May 12.

subfiles.title: HIKAWA and NORSELAND at Vancouver
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Navy Department
subfiles.about: Reports two vessel arrivals and HIKAWA’s departure.
subfiles.summary: HIKAWA arrived from Seattle and departed for Yokohama May 10; Panamanian NORSELAND arrived from San Pedro.

subfiles.title: FLORIDA MARU cargo at Manzanillo
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports strategic cargo loaded for Japan.
subfiles.summary: FLORIDA MARU arrived from Corinto and loaded fluorspar, lead, scrap tin, cotton and mercury before departing for Japan via Los Angeles. Some cotton came from MARINA O.

subfiles.title: KANTO MARU leaving Buenos Aires
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports KANTO MARU’s departure and route to Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: KANTO MARU arrived May 7 and left May 13 via Montevideo, Brazilian ports and Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Japanese vessels carrying tin to the Americas in 1940
subfiles.about: Tabulates refined tin and tin plate shipments by vessel, port, shipper and destination.
subfiles.summary: The table lists 1940 arrivals, quantities and export ports for Japanese ships carrying Straits refined tin and tin plate. Facing pages give shippers, consignees and destinations, followed by monthly recapitulations and totals.

subfiles.title: Direct reporting from Puntarenas to Balboa
subfiles.from: H. D. Bode, Office of Naval Intelligence
subfiles.to: Orme Wilson, State Department
subfiles.about: Approves direct naval reporting of Japanese ship movements from Puntarenas.
subfiles.summary: Navy agrees that San José should notify the 15th Naval District directly and inform State at the same time.

subfiles.title: Note on confidential Australian ship information
subfiles.about: Suggests ways to obtain confidential Australian ship movement information.
subfiles.summary: Suggests requesting the data under strict confidence, then consulting shipping publications if needed.

subfiles.title: Scope of Japanese vessel reports from Sydney
subfiles.from: H. D. Bode, Office of Naval Intelligence
subfiles.to: Orme Wilson, State Department
subfiles.about: Requests clarification that Sydney reports vessels bound for foreign as well as U.S. ports.
subfiles.summary: Navy asks that Sydney report Japanese naval vessels and large merchant ships regardless of destination, using the best available information.

subfiles.title: Reported Japanese convoy sighting
subfiles.to: Fourteenth Naval District
subfiles.about: Requests questioning witnesses to a reported Japanese convoy.
subfiles.summary: A PRESIDENT CLEVELAND passenger reportedly saw about 25 Japanese ships southbound; Navy requests details from witnesses at Honolulu.

subfiles.title: Routing note on attached correspondence
subfiles.about: Asks whether a draft response should be prepared.
subfiles.summary: Asks whether to draft a reply on the attached matter.

subfiles.title: State Department note on Manila intelligence request
subfiles.to: Hornbeck
subfiles.about: Assesses an unauthorized request for Japanese vessel movement reports.
subfiles.summary: Concludes that Manila Military Intelligence acted independently of Navy’s request and proposes disposing of the matter by telegram.

subfiles.title: War Department response on Manila request
subfiles.from: A. R. Harris, Military Intelligence Division
subfiles.to: State Department Liaison Officer
subfiles.about: Disavows Manila Military Intelligence’s request for vessel information.
subfiles.summary: War says Manila acted alone, advises State against complying, and will notify Manila.

subfiles.title: American Republics routing sheet
subfiles.about: Routes associated American republics correspondence.
subfiles.summary: Brief routing sheet with an illegible annotation.

subfiles.title: RAKUYO MARU at Buenaventura
subfiles.to: State Department
subfiles.about: Reports RAKUYO MARU’s route, passengers and German personnel.
subfiles.summary: RAKUYO MARU arrived from Valparaíso carrying about 275 passengers, including 18 Germans, and was bound for Yokohama via Mexican and U.S. ports.

subfiles.title: ARIMA MARU at Antofagasta
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports ARIMA MARU’s arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: ARIMA MARU arrived from Balboa May 9 and sailed for Coquimbo May 14.

subfiles.title: KANTO MARU at Montevideo
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; Office of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: Reports KANTO MARU’s arrival and onward route.
subfiles.summary: KANTO MARU arrived from Buenos Aires May 14 and was due to leave May 15 for Los Angeles via Brazil and Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: NORWAY MARU at Manzanillo
subfiles.to: Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Reports NORWAY MARU’s cargo exchange and departure.
subfiles.summary: NORWAY MARU arrived from Los Angeles, exchanged cargo, and sailed for Corinto May 14.
